summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Bridges Capital Tactical ETF (BDGS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that allocates between passively managed US total market ETFs, large-cap US stocks, and cash or cash equivalents through a tactical strategy based on macroeconomic events, changing market breadth, and volatility. BDGS was launched on May 11, 2023 and is issued by Bridges Capital.

holdings.infoBox: BDGS is an equity ETF with a total of 19 individual holdings. The top holdings are Alpha Architect 1-3 Month Box ETF stock at 54.39%, iShares Russell 2000 ETF at 4.93%, Meta Platforms at 3.68%, Applied Materials at 3.52%, and Tesla at 3.30%.
